objective: Deliver production-verifiable Platform-backed Maestro A2A swarm support with durable remote identity, discovery, delegation, task control, subagent routing, observability, signed evidence, and live external dereferencing.
globalInvariants: Replay fixtures prove schema compatibility only and cannot satisfy exit evidence for production stages.
Every production claim must name the authoritative system of record and the command, query, or verifier that resolves it.
Live evidence must redact raw tokens and payloads while preserving enough stable identifiers for independent verification.
Stages advance in order; later stages may add evidence but cannot weaken prior-stage gates.

stages.title: Integrity foundation
stages.purpose: Prevent local contract artifacts from being promoted as production proof and make live A2A evidence independently checkable.

entryEvidence.description: Existing replay artifacts can emit the expected evidence shape but do not prove real GitHub, Platform, or deploy activity.
entryEvidence.authoritativeSource: Repository fixtures and PR review notes
entryEvidence.verification: Run npm run check:evidence-integrity and inspect flagged production-looking local identifiers before promotion.

entryEvidence.description: The live-proof PR stack is open and scoped to evidence hardening rather than unrelated product changes.

exitEvidence.description: Precommit and CI reject production-looking evidence that uses constructed SHAs, slug PR refs, local run ids, or replay-only proof ids.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Maestro guardian hook and CI evidence-integrity check
exitEvidence.verification: npm run check:evidence-integrity && npm run test -- test/guardian/evidence-integrity.test.ts

exitEvidence.description: Live evidence verification can require GitHub Actions run ids and pull request numbers to resolve through the GitHub API.
exitEvidence.verification: GITHUB_TOKEN=$GITHUB_TOKEN npm run platform:a2a-evidence-verify -- <evidence.json> --require-github-dereference

exitEvidence.description: Live evidence bundles can be bound to an Ed25519 detached signature and trusted public-key fingerprint.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Signed evidence sidecar and verifier output
exitEvidence.verification: MAESTRO_A2A_LIVE_EVIDENCE_VERIFY_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE=<public-key.pem> npm run platform:a2a-evidence-verify -- <evidence.json> --require-signature

exitEvidence.description: The live smoke proves Platform Agent Registry peer discovery rejects an invalid token before happy-path delegation evidence is written.
exitEvidence.verification: MAESTRO_A2A_LIVE_REQUIRE_INVALID_TOKEN_PROBE=true npm run platform:a2a-delegation-live

stages.title: Platform identity and topology
stages.purpose: Make Platform the durable source of truth for two remote Maestro peers and their advertised A2A capabilities.

entryEvidence.description: Stage 0 guardrails are merged, green, and active in CI before live topology evidence is trusted.
entryEvidence.authoritativeSource: GitHub PR merge state and CI checks

entryEvidence.description: Two reachable Maestro A2A endpoints exist outside the local replay harness with distinct agent ids.
entryEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform runner inventory and A2A Agent Card endpoints
entryEvidence.verification: maestro a2a discover --capability a2a:task --import && maestro a2a peers

exitEvidence.description: Both remote Maestro instances register durable Platform agent ids with workspace, organization, endpoint, and capability metadata.
exitEvidence.verification: maestro a2a discover --capability a2a:task --skill maestro.subagent.code-review --import

exitEvidence.description: Platform discovery returns both peers only when capability, workspace, organization, and A2A dispatch filters match.
exitEvidence.verification: npm run platform:a2a-delegation-live with MAESTRO_A2A_LIVE_FROM_AGENT_ID and MAESTRO_A2A_LIVE_TO_AGENT_ID set, then npm run platform:a2a-evidence-verify -- <evidence.json> --require-discovery-evidence

exitEvidence.description: Both peers expose fresh heartbeat timestamps and Agent Card observation timestamps within the configured freshness window.
exitEvidence.verification: MAESTRO_A2A_LIVE_MAX_HEARTBEAT_AGE_MS=900000 npm run platform:a2a-delegation-live

exitEvidence.description: Operator-visible topology shows peer identity, capabilities, endpoint kind, capacity, and last-seen state without exposing tokens.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform audit or operator topology surface
exitEvidence.verification: Capture the Platform topology/audit record ids in the signed evidence bundle and verify the redaction fields.

stages.title: Remote delegation and task control
stages.purpose: Prove Maestro A can delegate work to Maestro B through Platform and control the resulting task lifecycle.

entryEvidence.description: Stage 1 identity, discovery, heartbeat, and audit evidence is current for the two participating peers.
The target peer advertises the required skill or capability before Platform accepts a delegation.

exitEvidence.description: Platform creates a durable delegation id that links from-agent id, to-agent id, workspace, skill, prompt hash, and remote task id.
exitEvidence.verification: npm run platform:a2a-delegation-live and inspect evidence.delegation.id plus evidence.delegation.a2aTaskId

exitEvidence.description: The remote A2A task is fetched from the target peer and reaches a terminal or explicitly configured nonterminal observation state.
exitEvidence.verification: npm run platform:a2a-delegation-live with MAESTRO_A2A_LIVE_REQUIRE_TERMINAL_TASK=true

exitEvidence.description: A Platform-owned control probe records mode, task id, optional control id, queue state, and observed task state.
exitEvidence.verification: Inspect evidence.control.mode, evidence.control.taskId, and evidence.control.observedAt in the signed bundle.

exitEvidence.description: The proof path uses Platform discovery, delegate, graph, control, and task observations rather than a hand-edited peer registry or private relay.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Smoke command environment and trace spans
exitEvidence.verification: Verify the evidence.platformEndpoint, graph nodes, trace spans, and absence of local peer-registry-only proof in the bundle.

stages.title: Subagent federation
stages.purpose: Let a remote Maestro expose governed subagent lanes that another Maestro can invoke through the Platform A2A boundary.

entryEvidence.description: A signed Stage 2 bundle proves remote delegation and task control for the same workspace.
The target Maestro advertises subagent lanes with stable ids, skill ids, input schema, policy, and ownership semantics.
entryEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform capability market or Agent Registry metadata

exitEvidence.description: The origin Maestro invokes a named subagent lane on the target Maestro through Platform and receives a child-run handle.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform AgentRuntime child-run or delegation graph
exitEvidence.verification: Inspect graph child nodes for childRunId, subagentLaneId, parentDelegationId, and rootDelegationId.

exitEvidence.description: The subagent call records requested capability, granted capability, fallback decision, and rejected unsupported modes.
exitEvidence.verification: Verify capability negotiation fields in the signed evidence bundle and targeted negative test output.

exitEvidence.description: Cross-peer subagent invocation fails closed when the origin lacks the required workspace, capability, or policy grant.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform authorization response and negative auth trace
exitEvidence.verification: Run the subagent federation negative-auth smoke and verify the denial trace id is present.

exitEvidence.description: Every child result includes parent task, remote peer, subagent lane, tool/evidence refs, and redaction-safe artifact ids.
exitEvidence.verification: Verify the child-run provenance chain from root delegation to final artifact in Platform traces.

stages.title: Swarm coordination
stages.purpose: Coordinate multiple Maestro instances so work can be split, owned, recovered, and reconciled into one coherent outcome.

entryEvidence.description: Stage 3 proves remote subagent invocation, negotiation, authZ, and provenance for the swarm participants.
entryEvidence.verification: Verify Stage 3 evidence signature, trace ids, child-run ids, and authorization denial ids.

entryEvidence.description: Platform can store a shared work graph with root task, child tasks, ownership claims, dependencies, and outcome refs.
entryEvidence.verification: Create a dry-run work graph and verify the returned root work id and child lane ids resolve through Platform.

exitEvidence.description: The root Maestro records a plan that splits a real task into remote child lanes with dependencies and acceptance gates.
exitEvidence.verification: Inspect the root work graph for split decisions, child assignments, dependency edges, and acceptance gates.

exitEvidence.description: Each file, task, external action, or PR lane has a single active owner or an explicit handoff record.
exitEvidence.verification: Query ownership claims and verify no active overlapping claims exist for the same protected resource.

exitEvidence.description: A remote worker failure, timeout, or drain produces reassignment or graceful degradation with preserved evidence.
exitEvidence.verification: Run the swarm failure smoke and verify reassignment, terminal state, and recovered artifact refs.

exitEvidence.description: The root Maestro reconciles child outputs into one final answer, branch, PR, or deploy decision with traceable sources.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform outcome ledger and GitHub PR state
exitEvidence.verification: Inspect final outcome refs, merged child artifact ids, root trace id, and linked GitHub PR or deploy verifier ids.

stages.title: Production proof and operations
stages.purpose: Run the full Platform-backed swarm path against live repos and deploy lanes with independently resolvable operational evidence.

entryEvidence.description: Stage 4 proves multi-peer work split, ownership, recovery, and reconciliation with signed Platform evidence.
entryEvidence.verification: Verify Stage 4 evidence signature, Platform trace ids, ownership ledger ids, and final outcome refs.

entryEvidence.description: A real repository or deploy lane is selected with safe blast radius, review path, rollback path, and operator approval.
entryEvidence.authoritativeSource: GitHub issue or PR and deployment plan
entryEvidence.verification: Inspect the linked GitHub issue or PR body for scope, test plan, rollback plan, and approval state.

exitEvidence.description: The evidence names a 40-hex commit SHA returned by git rev-parse for the branch that produced the PR.
exitEvidence.verification: git rev-parse HEAD && gh pr view <number> --repo <owner/repo> --json headRefOid

exitEvidence.description: The proof links to a real integer GitHub pull request with review state, base/head refs, and merge status.
exitEvidence.verification: gh pr view <number> --repo <owner/repo> --json number,url,state,mergedAt,reviewDecision

exitEvidence.description: The proof links to a real GitHub Actions run id with job logs for required checks.
exitEvidence.verification: gh run view <run-id> --repo <owner/repo> --json databaseId,status,conclusion,jobs,url

exitEvidence.description: The complete production evidence bundle is hash-linked, signed, and verifies with the trusted public key.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Signed evidence sidecar and verifier output
exitEvidence.verification: npm run platform:a2a-evidence-verify -- <evidence.json> --require-signature --require-github-dereference --require-negative-auth-probe

exitEvidence.description: If the task touches deployment, the deploy verifier records the observed revision, rollout status, and rollback evidence.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Deploy verifier and GitOps repository state
exitEvidence.verification: Run the deploy verifier for the target lane and attach its dereferenceable outcome id to the evidence bundle.

exitEvidence.description: Operators can inspect root trace, child traces, task lifecycle, control events, GitHub refs, and deploy refs from the Platform UI or API.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform trace store and operator UI
exitEvidence.verification: Open the root trace id and verify every child run and external ref resolves from the operator surface.

stages.title: Fleet hardening
stages.purpose: Turn the proven end-to-end path into a durable fleet service with load, chaos, SLO, quota, retention, and incident evidence.

entryEvidence.description: Stage 5 proves a complete live repo or deploy-lane workflow with signed, dereferenceable evidence.
entryEvidence.verification: Verify Stage 5 evidence signature, GitHub dereference, deploy-verifier output, and root Platform trace id.

entryEvidence.description: Target concurrency, latency, failure budgets, data retention, and operator ownership are declared before hardening starts.
entryEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform SLO document or service config
entryEvidence.verification: Inspect the service config or SLO document for concrete fleet-scale thresholds and owners.

exitEvidence.description: A bounded load and soak test exercises concurrent peer discovery, delegation, subagent routing, control, and evidence writes.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Load test report and Platform metrics
exitEvidence.verification: Run the fleet soak harness and verify p95 latency, error rate, and evidence-write success rate against SLO.

exitEvidence.description: Peer loss, stale heartbeat, auth failure, Platform transient failure, GitHub failure, and deploy verifier failure have tested recovery behavior.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Chaos test report and recovery traces
exitEvidence.verification: Run the A2A swarm chaos suite and verify each injected fault has a terminal recovery or degraded outcome.

exitEvidence.description: Fleet dashboards and alerts cover registration freshness, delegation latency, task terminal rate, auth failures, evidence verification failures, and queue depth.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform observability dashboard and alert config
exitEvidence.verification: Inspect dashboard panels and alert rules, then attach their stable ids to the release evidence.

exitEvidence.description: Operators have a playbook for stuck delegations, poisoned peers, key rotation, bad evidence, failed deploy verification, and rollback.
exitEvidence.verification: Run the playbook checklist against a staging incident and link the checklist result to the hardening evidence.

exitEvidence.description: Workspace quotas, per-peer limits, evidence retention, signature key rotation, and redaction retention policies are enforced.
exitEvidence.authoritativeSource: Platform policy engine and retention jobs
exitEvidence.verification: Run policy probes for over-quota delegation, expired evidence lookup, and retired signature key verification.
